ga_06_56.text: In the film Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002), besides scolding Ron, whom does Molly congratulate in his Howler?
ga_06_56.explanation: The film's Howler congratulates Ginny on being sorted into Gryffindor. This congratulation is not part of the book's Howler message.
ga_06_56.source: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002), Howler scene; licensed Thames & Kosmos Harry Potter Letters manual, page 18

ga_13_03.text: According to the official Harry Potter Encyclopedia, what breed of dragon do the trio release from Gringotts?
ga_13_03.explanation: The official encyclopedia identifies the dragon as a Ukrainian Ironbelly. The novel itself does not name its breed.
